title: Cross-linguistic disagreement as a conflict of semantic alignment norms in multilingual AI

bias_targets.methodology: Presenting philosophical thought experiments (scenarios evaluating 'knowledge-how' attributions for physical and intellectual abilities) to conversational LLMs in both English and Japanese, and comparing the models' Yes/No truth-value judgments to see if they align with language-specific human folk intuitions or inappropriately enforce a uniform cross-linguistic norm (often English-centric).
